notes: Replication title and authors verified against assigned reference. Description prioritised for selecting the average-person paired test; target_match=false records the explicit Table 10 locator conflict. Table 10 heart-attack likelihood instead prints F(3, 580) = 14.58 and p <.001 across four targets (N=584); these omnibus values were not merged with the pairwise test. Table 11 additionally prints Cohen’s d=-0.60, but requested test statistic retained. Table 8 prints average-person n=147, while Table 11 prints t(249); exact paired-test analytic n therefore left null. Authors describe this specific average-person result as supported, while their overall replication verdict is partial/mixed. Original statistics reproduced in the replication manuscript were not substituted for independently acquired original-paper evidence. Original acquisition: DOI 403; Unpaywall closed; OpenAlex no OA location; no full-text route in open search; ResearchGate alternative 403. No failed route retried.
